title: Heap-Priority Preservation and Height-Balanced Invariants in a Swift Treap Randomized Binary Search Tree
topic: Treap Randomized Binary Search Tree with Heap Priorities

abstract: We present a deterministic Swift implementation of a randomized binary search tree that couples binary search ordering with a heap-priority discipline. The structure guarantees that each insertion or deletion preserves the binary search property while maintaining the heap property on a pseudo-random priority field generated by a linear congruential generator. We formally prove that the tree remains height-balanced with an expected depth of $O(\log N)$ and that all key-ordered and heap invariants hold after each mutation. The implementation is fully reproducible; the priority sequence is deterministic for a fixed seed, enabling exact replay of experiments. The source code is available at \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/swift-systems-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261020_010131_treap_randomized_binary_search}.
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints
